title: How Much Does a Small Business Website Cost in Illinois?

cover.alt: Concept illustration of a website project budget organized into build, ongoing care, and optional scope.

figures.title: Separate the project into cost layers
figures.summary: A build quote is only one part of the website budget.

items.label: Domain registration
items.detail: Keep the domain in the business owner's account.

items.label: Website build
items.detail: Confirm the pages and features covered by the one-time scope.

items.label: Hosting and care
items.detail: Understand ongoing hosting, updates, monitoring, and backup responsibilities.

items.label: Optional extras
items.detail: Scope content, photography, commerce, and marketing separately when needed.

figures.caption: Cost categories from this article. Check the current pricing page and written scope for applicable amounts.

figures.title: Build a complete first-year budget
figures.summary: Account for recurring costs and the materials required to finish the site.

items.label: Choose a build scope
items.detail: Start with the pages and functions the business actually needs.

items.label: Add ongoing costs
items.detail: Include a year of care and the domain renewal.

items.label: Identify missing materials
items.detail: Plan for writing, photos, email hosting, or branding where relevant.

items.label: Allow for changes
items.detail: Discuss likely additions before approving the final estimate.

figures.caption: A planning sequence drawn from the budgeting and hidden-cost sections; it is not a new price quote.
